items.t: OpenAI Debuts New ChatGPT Payment Method With Card Networks
items.d: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a new secure payment method that its artificial intelligence tool can use to make purchases on consumers’ behalf, renewing its push into AI shopping after winding down an Instant Checkout feature earlier this year.
items.fullText: Technology AI OpenAI Debuts New ChatGPT Payment Method With Card Networks Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Gift this article Contact us: Provide news feedback or report an error Confidential tip? Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Natalie Lung November 13, 2026 at 5:06 PM UTC Bookmark Save OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a new secure payment method that its artificial intelligence tool can use to make purchases on consumers’ behalf, renewing its push into AI shopping after winding down an Instant Checkout feature earlier this year. The virtual wallet, built in partnership with American Express Co. , Mastercard Inc. and Visa Inc. , lets users add a card once and approve each purchase without reentering their payment details, OpenAI said in a statement Friday. AI agents handling the purchase don’t have access to users’ actual card details, and each transaction will require biometric verification, such as Face ID or a fingerprint scan.

items.t: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.d: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
items.fullText: ChatGPT can now shop for you. On Friday, OpenAI launched a new wallet feature that lets its agents, called dots , help you decide what to buy and then complete the purchase on your behalf. The option will initially be available to a limited number of U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers, ages 18 and up, with a U.S.-issued Visa, Mastercard, or American Express. OpenAI says that users are fully in control of the purchases, as they’re able to review the items, the total, and the payment card that will be used to complete the transaction before the checkout occurs. In addition, users will approve the purchases directly with a security check like Face ID or a fingerprint, which creates a record of their transaction. The addition comes as consumer-facing AI tools are working to find the right product-market fit, in terms of how they can help people be more efficient as they complete various tasks. While companies like DoorDash and Uber have so far reported low numbers of orders placed by AI agents, Meta’s Muse, which now has over 10 million users, has seen AI-assisted shopping become a top activity on its app. Other personal AI agents, like Instinct, also support making purchases on users’ behalf. It’s no surprise, then, that OpenAI would want to enter this space more with an agentic shopping feature of its own. To get started, ChatGPT subscribers add their eligible payment cards to the new ChatGPT Wallet, then ask their dot to help with a purchase. (This setup is a one-time thing; users don’t have to re-enter their payment information every time they buy.) When it’s time to transact, ChatGPT’s Wallet charges the selected card using a payment token, which is a substitute for the user’s actual card details, so that information isn’t shared with either the dot or the merchant. The merchant will automatically receive what it needs to fulfill the order from the dot, like the shipping address and contact information, OpenAI says. T

[사진= 전자신문 DB] 바라트 랑가라잔 옴니사 최고제품책임자(CPO)는 망분리 규제가 완화돼도 국내 금융권에서 가상 데스크톱 '호라이즌'의 역할은 더욱 커질 것이라고 강조했다. 규제 대응용 가상데스크톱인프라(VDI)를 넘어, 금융사가 AI 에이전트를 안전하게 가동하는 '격리 작업공간'으로 쓰임새를 넓히겠다는 복안이다. 랑가라잔 CPO는 13일 도쿄에서 열린 '옴니사 원 도쿄 2026'에서 전자신문과 만나 “호라이즌은 사람과 AI 에이전트가 나란히 일할 수 있는 안전하고 통제된 환경을 제공한다”며 “에이전트가 민감한 애플리케이션·데이터와 상호작용해야 하는 금융기관에 특히 적합하다”고 말했다. 호라이즌은 에이전트가 격리된 가상 데스크톱 안에서 기존 접근·보안 정책에 따라 업무 앱을 다루는 방식이다. 망분리 완화로 VDI 수요가 줄 것이란 시각에는 선을 그었다. 그는 “한국 금융 고객들은 망분리 규제 완화 때문에 VDI를 완전히 떠나고 있지 않다”며 “VDI 수요의 전면적 감소라기보다 고객 우선순위가 바뀌고 있다”고 말했다. 전통적 망분리용 수요는 점진적으로 바뀔 수 있지만, 안전한 업무 접근과 데이터 보호, 핵심 업무 앱에 대한 유연한 접근으로 호라이즌의 입지를 다질 기회가 있다는 설명이다. 한국 고객 사이에서는 호라이즌을 다른 가상화 플랫폼에서 구동하려는 관심도 높다. 옴니사는 뉴타닉스 AHV, 레드햇 오픈시프트 지원으로 선택지를 넓히고 있다. 오픈시프트는 격리된 가상머신(VM)에서 AI 에이전트를 실행할 또 다른 환경이 될 수 있다는 설명이다. 망분리 이후 보안 모델로는 제로트러스트를 제시했다. 사내망 접속 여부가 아니라 신원과 단말 보안 상태, 정책에 따라 접근을 통제하는 방식이다. 호라이즌으로 데이터와 앱 접근을 중앙에서 통제하고, 통합엔드포인트관리(UEM) 플랫폼 '워크스페이스 원'으로 단말 규정 준수와 신원 기반 접근 정책을 적용한다. 다만 가상화만으로 모든 앱 취약점이나 API 공격을 막을 수는 없어 앱 보안과 신원 통제를 병행해야 한다고 덧붙였다. 지난 10월 신한·KB국민·하나은행 고객정보 유출 사고와 관련해서는 핵심 뱅킹 시스템을 넘어 임직원 단말, 모바일 앱, 외부 연계 서비스까지 보안을 넓혀야 한다고 지적했다. 당시 해킹은 대출모집인 전용 서비스, 직원용 모바일 업무 지원 시스템 등 외곽 시스템을 노렸다. 옴니사는 국내 금융기관과 보안 요구사항 해결 방안을 논의하고 있다. 금융권 AI 에이전트 도입은 IT 운영에서 시작될 것으로 내다봤다. 그는 “실질적 도입은 AI 에이전트를 민감한 뱅킹 환경에 들이는 데 필요한 대체 보안 통제 수립에 달렸다”며 “문제 해결, 취약점 관리 등 IT 운영 영역부터 시작할 기회가 있다”고 말했다. 에이전트에 무제한으로 넘겨선 안 될 권한으로는 보안 정책 변경, 특권 접근 허용, 주요 시스템의 중대한 변경을 꼽았다. AI 통제 솔루션 '옴니사 엘라라'는 내년 상반기 정식 출시(GA)가 목표다. 다만 한국 출시 일정과 금융보안원 서비스형소프트웨어(SaaS) 보안 평가 대응 방안을 묻는 말에는 “아직 발표된 세부 사항이 없다”고 답했다. 류태웅 기자 bigheroryu@etnews.com

Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
items.d: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.
items.fullText: Google Search is getting better at understanding complicated questions, including those with multiple parts, highly specific requests, or confusing typos. The updates are coming via the company’s newly released Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, which Google claims is its “biggest model improvement to Search yet.” While Google’s frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, are best at deep reasoning for hard problems, Hydrogen is designed for fast execution across a variety of agentic workflows, or tasks in which an AI carries out multiple steps on its own, the company explained in an announcement. The idea behind the model’s release is that using the most powerful model isn’t always needed — sometimes a faster, cheaper, and reasonably smart one will do. Google says Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, its previous fast model, but it’s still pretty smart, even beating the more powerful Gemini 4 Argon on one broad intelligence benchmark, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , at its default high thinking level. In Search, Hydrogen brings several improvements, including a better understanding of user intent, the ability to offer more helpful links and visual responses, and better answers across the different languages supported by Google’s AI Mode. In terms of intent, Google says Hydrogen can handle more nuanced and complicated questions more quickly. This means people can ask their questions in their natural train of thought, including those that have multiple parts or that include highly specific requests. Hydrogen is also better at navigating hard-to-understand typos, Google says. Because of its improvements and better ability to follow instructions and call the right tools, Hydrogen is able to more precisely address each part of a user’s question. items.t: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
items.d: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.
items.fullText: Nectar , an AI-powered operating system for marketing, is launching a new AI agent designed to take a lot of the manual work out of influencer marketing, from finding the right creators to contacting them, managing partnerships, and tracking results. Founded by sisters Misbah and Farah Uraizee, both former Meta employees, Nectar came out of stealth last year and uses AI agents to help brands manage social media, customer conversations, content moderation, creator partnerships, and competitor research. Announced Thursday, its new “Creator Agent” can search for creators, check their content and brand partnerships, send personalized messages, coordinate collaborations, and monitor how campaigns perform. Instead of having marketing teams spend weeks scrolling through social media, building spreadsheets, and sending individual DMs, Nectar wants its agent to handle much of that work automatically. Nectar joins other companies introducing agentic AI assistants designed to automate influencer outreach, including Aspire and GRIN . The launch also comes as more brands turn to creators to reach customers. U.S. spending on creator advertising is expected to reach $44 billion in 2026, according to the Interactive Advertising Bureau . As companies work with hundreds or even thousands of creators, keeping track of relationships and measuring results can get pretty difficult. Nectar says its Creator Agent searches more than 300 million creator profiles to find potential partners, including smaller creators who may not yet have a large following but are gaining traction. The system analyzes videos to understand what creators post about, how their content fits a brand, and whether their previous partnerships are appropriate. It also checks brand safety by reviewing content in context rather than simply searching for specific keywords. United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks
items.d: The airline said it will not allow customers to use AI agents to book flights and manage reservations.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 9:17 AM PST · November 12, 2026 Image Credits: Skyhobo / Getty Images Zack Whittaker United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks United Airlines said it will restrict access to AI agents seeking to book flights and manage reservations on their users’ behalf, citing a risk to cybersecurity and undermining federal regulations. The airline is the latest American corporate giant to prevent customers from using AI agents and autonomous assistants to access their systems. The move comes as airlines and banks are struggling to differentiate between real customers and AI systems operating on their behalf, such as when users share their logins with their AI assistants. Sharing passwords with apps and assistants can create security risks if those credentials get leaked or exposed. United warns that “sharing account credentials with personal, third-party, AI assistants can expose sensitive information, and actions taken by these tools may result in unintended purchases, account changes, or use of MileagePlus miles.” The airline also warns of a risk of violating federal aviation rules, such as requiring that a human completes flight check-ins to acknowledge that their bags do not contain banned substances. “As a result, United is taking steps to restrict access — directly within our digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators — to prohibit use by unauthorized, third-party personal AI agents or assistants,” the airline said in a statement . “This work includes updates to our booking, ticketing and distribution policies.” The airline’s move follows a warning from banks, including Bank of America, which last week urged customers not to share their passwords with their AI assistants. items.fullText: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets. November 8, 2026 by Nicola Sessions 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents. items.fullText: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents November 5, 2026 by Hannah Coutand 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action. Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task. As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those steps quickly and support many agents at once, all within the limits of available power. What this means: AI infrastructure providers need to support more agents without making each one wait longer to get work done. And critically, AI factories are power limited. This means operators need to choose infrastructure that maximizes the work done for every watt. Why it matters: NVIDIA Vera delivers both fast agent performance and high capacity per watt within a single CPU. That gives providers one CPU for a range of agent workloads, rather than having to mix and match fast and dense x86 parts to balance speed and capacity. The data that proves it: In a 100-megawatt data center comparison, NVIDIA found that a single Vera CPU performs better than the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Vera delivers industry-leading agent speed while enabling 1.6x more agents per watt versus the fastest x86 CPU. Vera delivers 2x faster agent speed with leading energy efficiency compared with the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Partners are already putting Vera to work. Early adopters see the same exceptional performance in production-style tests: Perplexity : Ran agentic coding tasks 1.5x faster with Vera than on traditional CPUs. Perplexity plans to deploy Vera in an upcoming production system.
